name: ShipRust
description: Generate a Rust SaaS codebase with accounts, billing, and deployment built in.
overview: Choose the pieces your app needs, from sign-in and background jobs to billing and a blog. ShipRust generates a Rust repository you can download, run locally, and deploy yourself. The pages are rendered on the server with Axum and Maud, and application data lives in Postgres.

name: TastefulKit
description: A searchable library of real websites, components, and design guides.
overview: Compare landing pages in pairs to work out which designs you like. When you're ready to build, you can search the library for a specific layout or component. The MCP integration lets a coding agent retrieve a reference, its screenshot, and the accompanying design notes where available.

name: Drape
description: Photograph your clothes and put together outfits on your phone.
overview: Start with photos of the clothes you own. Save them to your wardrobe, review item details, and group pieces into looks you can find again later. The repository includes native iPhone and Android apps, with local wardrobe storage and a separate backend for image processing.

name: nitpick
description: Get a second opinion on a code change before you merge it.
overview: A diff can look reasonable until you read the code that calls it. nitpick sends the changed files and nearby code to a second model for review. Run it from the command line or hook it into a coding agent to get findings while the changes are still fresh.

name: Built with Rust
description: Discover apps, websites, and tools written in Rust.
overview: Browse finished websites, apps, and developer tools to see where people are using Rust. The weekly newsletter follows new projects and Rust news. The directory is itself written in Rust, and its implementation is available alongside the projects it features.

name: Built with Bend
description: A human-reviewed directory of projects built with Bend.
overview: Browse what people are making with Bend 2, from small experiments to games and tools. Submissions are reviewed by a person, and entries link to the build and its source so you can try it and see how it works. A weekly newsletter collects discoveries from the directory.

name: LVTD Games
description: Small, independently built browser games. Pick a game and play.
overview: The arcade includes a Russian five-letter word puzzle, a two-player city race, chess against Jev, and a playable version of Conway's Game of Life. Each game opens directly in the browser and has its own controls. The collection and the games are developed together in a public repository.

name: Jev Benchmark
description: Compare AI answers head to head and inspect what each answer cost.

name: Rowset
description: Give an agent a private dataset it can query, edit, and export.
overview: An agent can record findings in a table during one session and pick up the same rows in the next. Rowset provides private datasets for this kind of work, with tools to query, update, and export records through MCP, REST, or the command line. You can also run it yourself.

name: PGSandbox
description: Test SQL in a disposable Postgres database.
overview: Give a coding agent its own temporary Postgres database to try a migration, check a query, or reproduce a database bug. Each sandbox has a scoped role and an expiry time. The agent works against real Postgres and can discard the database when the experiment is over.

name: CiteGuild
description: Find articles to cite from a network of independent publishers.
overview: Publishers make their articles discoverable to writing agents. An agent working on a draft can search by subject, read a matching excerpt, and follow the original link to check whether it supports the passage. The search is available through MCP, a command-line tool, and an API.

name: AI Steering
description: A field guide to the files that give coding agents repository context.

name: Djass
description: Generate a Django SaaS codebase with the modules you need.
overview: Choose the modules for a Django app, including authentication, billing, and background jobs. Djass packages those choices into a repository with deployment defaults and project instructions for the next developer or coding agent. The downloadable agent skills let you start that process from your editor.

name: Browse Awesome
description: Search and monitor repositories discovered across curated awesome lists.
overview: Awesome lists collect recommendations across thousands of GitHub repositories. Browse Awesome brings those recommendations into one search and shows recent stars and commits, so you can tell which projects have been getting attention. A weekly digest highlights new discoveries.

name: Staleaway
description: Get a reminder when a page on your site is due for review.
overview: Add a sitemap and choose how often you want to revisit the pages. Staleaway sends a small batch of links by email when they're due, giving you a manageable reading list for checking old instructions, links, and copy.

name: Talent Leads
description: Lead generation for startup hiring teams that need targeted outreach inputs.

name: Built with Django
description: Developer education, product discovery, and useful examples for Django builders.
overview: Find projects people have shipped with Django and follow the links to try them. Alongside the showcase, the site publishes practical guides, Django jobs, and community resources. The directory itself is a Django application with a public codebase.

name: Tech Job Alerts
description: Automated matching and alerts for people tracking technical roles.

name: Is It Keto
description: Look up foods and ingredients to find out whether they fit a keto diet.
overview: Browse by food category or look up the particular product in your kitchen. There are entries for everyday ingredients such as olive oil as well as brand-specific foods like unsweetened vanilla almond milk. Each entry addresses that product's place in a keto diet.

name: rasulkireev.com
description: Website built by LVTD for Rasul Kireev. The writing, projects, and ongoing work are Rasul's.
overview: The site brings together book reviews, programming tutorials, project ideas, and the Tuesday Letter. Readers can move between a short personal note and a longer technical article in the same collection. The public Astro repository shows how those pieces fit together.

name: Meliora Advisory
description: Website built by LVTD for an independently owned advisory business. LVTD does not own or operate the business.
overview: Meliora advises industrial and business services firms on acquisitions, sales, and valuations. Its website brings the firm's services together with transaction histories, quarterly reports, and notes on due diligence, so prospective clients can explore its work before getting in touch.

name: Ask HN Digest
description: Read summaries of popular Ask HN discussions.

name: LevReview
description: Collect and manage customer reviews.

name: ReviewGate
description: Run automated code checks before merging a pull request.

name: TuxSEO
description: Build and publish pages for programmatic SEO.

name: OSIG
description: Generate social preview images from templates.

name: StatusHen
description: Monitor uptime and publish a status page.
